text:
Maya K: Heads-up — planning an EU-edge routing policy update tonight 23:00 UTC. Small tilt to new routing policy (5% -> 50%) over ~30m. Smoke checks at start, +15m, +30m. @Vikram S @Olivia P can you own deploy + smoke?

Vikram S: I can own the deploy. Will kick at 23:00 UTC and post the deploy bot output here. I’ll set the canary policy to 5% initially then run gradual ramp.

Olivia P: I’ll run the smoke checklist and monitor latency/ERR rates in the dashboard. What metrics to watch specifically?

Maya K: Primary checks: p95 latency, 5xx rate, connection error rate, and tail RT. Also verify prefix cache hit % and key-value errors. If anything spikes >2x baseline or 5xx >0.1% roll back.

Samir R: I’ll prepare rollback commands and keep a runbook handy. Rollback plan: (1) revert routing policy to previous weights, (2) flush edge caches if necessary, (3) revert DNS TTL (if changed).

ops-oncall: Please @ops-oncall when you start and when ramp hits 50%. I’ll be on standby.

Vikram S: Quick config snippet I’ll apply:

```
policy:
  name: eu-edge-2026-03
  steps:
    - weight: 5
      duration: 5m
    - weight: 25
      duration: 10m
    - weight: 50
      duration: 15m
ttl: 60  # seconds for temporary steering
```

Olivia P: For smoke commands I’ll run these:
`curl -sf https://eu-edge.health/api/v1/ping || echo FAIL`
`curl -sS https://eu-edge.metrics/api/latency?window=5m | jq .p95`
Also checking trace sampling for any 500s.

Maya K: Note on DNS: we’ll lower the routing TTL to 60s 10m before deploy. Keep change window short. If we need a fast rollback, TTL 60 helps.

Samir R: Rollback snippets:
`redwoodctl routing apply --policy eu-edge-prod-prior`
`redwoodctl edge cache flush --region eu`
Also I’ll pre-stage the old policy JSON in /tmp/previous-policy.json.

Vikram S: Kicking off at 23:00. Posting deploy-bot logs as they happen. Will tag :rocket:.

sre-bot: deploy-bot started by Vikram S at 2026-03-17T23:00:05Z — canary 5% applied.

Olivia P: 23:05 smoke check — p95 steady, 5xx 0.02%, cache hit 92%. All looking good. :thumbsup:

Vikram S: Ramp to 25% at 23:10. Will report back at +15m.

Olivia P: 23:25 smoke — p95 +12% (expected), 5xx 0.03% still within threshold. No tracer spikes.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged, staying on standby.

Maya K: If anyone sees anything outside thresholds call rollback. If not, after 50% ramp and 30m stable we mark as complete and revert TTL back to 300s.

Samir R: Ready to execute rollback if needed; will confirm in thread before running.

Vikram S: Final ramp to 50% done at 23:35. Leaving notes in the runbook.

Olivia P: Final smoke at 23:40 — all green. Will update the post-deploy checklist and close the task.

Maya K: Thanks team — great coordination. I’ll create follow-up ticket to track perf baseline for next week.
